newsitem.title: USA: Puget Power, Wash. Energy dividends set.
newsitem.headline: Puget Power, Wash. Energy dividends set.

text.p: In anticipation of early 1997 approval of their merger, Puget Sound Power & Light Co and Washington Energy Co said Wednesday they have executed an agreement governing payment of dividends to shareholders of both companies prior to the merger.

Under terms of the agreement, Washington Energy declared on December 9 a special prorated common stock dividend accruing at an annual rate of $1.00 per share from the last Washington Energy common stock payment date to the actual date the merger becomes effective.

After the merger is approved by the Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission and the Boards of Directors of the two companies, the obligation to pay the special Washington Energy dividend will be assumed by the new company, Puget Sound Energy Company (PSE).

The agreement also provides that PSE declare a special prorated dividend on the shares of common stock that would be issued to Washington Energy shareholders who become PSE shareholders on the date the merger is effective.
This special dividend will accrue at an annual rate of $1.84 per share from the date the merger is effective up through, and including, the next regularly scheduled dividend payment date.

For example, should the merger become effective on January 31, the special prorated dividends would accrue at an annual rate of $1.00 per share from December 9, 1996, to January 31, 1997, and at an annual rate of $1.84 per share from February 1, 1997, to February 15, 1997.

The special dividends would be paid on February 15, 1997, which would be the first regularly scheduled dividend payment date for PSE, to Washington Energy common stock shareholders of record the close of business on the January 31 effective date.

The agreement also includes the declaration and payment by Puget Power of a regular quarterly common stock dividend of 46-cents per share payable on February 15, 1997, to its shareholders of record on January 17, 1997. The 1997 dividend payment schedule for Puget Sound Energy Company will be February 15, May 15, August 15, and November 15.
